correctness.rationale: Over splitting K, characters form a basis and direct substitution gives F_chi F_psi=N 1_{psi=chi^-2} F_chi^-1. The nonfixed -2 cycles have length at least three; their characters span the commutator ideal, orthogonal to the commutative fixed-character ideal. Every target cyclic coefficient vector is represented by adjacent 2x2 determinants via an explicit 3-cycle base and contraction/insertion induction over arbitrary fields; assembling across independent cycles yields one commutator for every derived element. The exact dimension is N-|A[3]| and the width zero/one boundary follows from the existence of nonfixed characters. A standalone script reproduces product identities, rank and one-commutator witnesses; finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A published open problem explicitly asks for dihedral-quandle commutator widths. The theorem gives the exact width, explicit one-commutator algorithm, exact derived dimension and orthogonal ideal decomposition for *all* odd finite abelian core quandles (including noncyclic groups), in infinitely many field/group combinations. It clarifies a genuine coefficient boundary because the motivating paper exhibits R5 over F5 of width two outside the assumptions. This is not a finite table or a cosmetic variant of existing bounds.
